subject: Error trying to use recordtable function (incorporating deltaT) and assesstemporalindependence

messages.author: f0c924d9432872b2
messages.subject: Error trying to use recordtable function (incorporating deltaT) and assesstemporalindependence
parts:
Greetings! 

I am having trouble incorporating the argument minDeltaTime within the recordtable function to be able to have temporal independence between sightings. I am trying to filter the dataset to only include the sightings spaced more than 10 min apart from the previous sighting. 

I am able to use the recordtable function with only these arguments incorporated --> 
recordtable_allsites <- recordTable(inDir = image_file_path,
                                    IDfrom = "metadata",
                                    metadataSpeciesTag = "Species",) 

But when I try to incorporate the minDeltaTime, etc. as so -->

recordtable_allsites <- recordTable(inDir = image_file_path,
                                    IDfrom = "metadata",
                                    metadataSpeciesTag = "Species",
                                    minDeltaTime = 10,
                                    deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastRecord",
                                    exclude = "Empty", "Person", "Unidentified",
                                    removeDuplicateRecords = TRUE,
                                    returnFileNamesMissingTags = FALSE,) 

I get an error --> 
Error in match.arg(cameraID, choices = c("filename", "directory")) : 
  'arg' should be one of “filename”, “directory”

I am not sure how to interpret this error or what might be wrong. 
I have also tried manually filtering the dataset to have a deltaTime of greater than 10, but this does not incorporate the "since last sighting" so removes far more sightings than I want. 

As an alternative, I searched this group and found others who were trying to use the assesstemporalindependence function and am able to run this function 

deer_filter10 <- camtrapR:::assessTemporalIndependence(deer,
                                      deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",
                                      columnOfInterest = "Species",
                                      stationCol = "Station",
                                      cameraCol = "Station",
                                      camerasIndependent = TRUE,
                                      minDeltaTime = 10
)

but it results in an almost empty dataframe (with 1 line at the top and the rest with NAs). A strange thing with this function is that I read that the cameraCol argument should be optional (as I only have 1 camera per station), but when I try to run it without it, I get this error ( Error in Ops.data.frame(intable[, cameraCol], intable[xy, cameraCol]) : 
  ‘==’ only defined for equally-sized data frames).  So I am not sure what is wrong here...

And then when I try to run it independent of the camtrapR package, it gives me the error that it can't find the function (Error in assessTemporalIndependence(intable = deer, deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",  : 
  could not find function "assessTemporalIndependence") 

deer_filter10_min <- assessTemporalIndependence(intable = deer,
                                                  deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",
                                                  columnOfInterest = "Species",
                                                  stationCol = "Station",
                                                  cameraCol = "Station",
                                                  camerasIndependent = TRUE,
                                                  minDeltaTime = 10
)

Any advice you might have on this is greatly appreciated!! Thank you so much for your help!

Best, Laura

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error trying to use recordtable function (incorporating deltaT) and assesstemporalindependence
parts:
Hi Laura, 
apologies for the late reply. I believe the issue is that you didn't put the arguments for exclude in c().

Hence R will assume "Person" and "Unidentified" refer to differnent (unnamed) arguments. And since cameraID is the first argument that is not included yes, it will think that you mean cameraID = "Person".

See if it works with:
 exclude = c("Empty", "Person", "Unidentified"),

If possible please try to avoid the workflow with assessTemporalIndependence, it is just a very bad workaround at the moment and not a proper solution.
Best regards,
Jürgen
